The '''Open Circle Fleet''', or the '''Open Circle Armada''', was a major space fleet of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Galactic Republic's navy]] during the days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. This armada rose to prominence during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], when it was under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The elite pilots of the Open Circle Fleet won countless victories for the Republic Navy against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], including the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].

==History==
In battle, the Open Circle Fleet was led by Generals Kenobi and Skywalker. These were not the only Jedi pilots in the armada; [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] commanded a squad that consisted of both [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]]. While the Jedi may have been the most visible pilots of the armada, it also comprised thousands of clone and non-clone pilots, gunners, and officers. By the end of the Clone Wars, the Open Circle Armada had grown to include at least five Republic [[Sector fleet/Legends|fleets]], such as the [[Fifth Fleet/Legends|Fifth Fleet]].

[[File:Btlbywing.png|thumb|left|200px|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers and [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] from the Open Circle Fleet during the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] crisis.]]

These smaller sector fleets were more than able to hold their own against the Separatist forces, allowing the armada to function as several smaller independent groups at once. Of the fleet's numerous starfighter squadrons, [[Clone Flight Squad Seven/Legends|Clone Flight Squad Seven]], led by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Davijaan/Legends|Odd Ball]], was the most experienced and elite squadron of them all. The lighter vanguard ships for the fleet were [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]]. [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] were also used early in the war. Each of these medium warships could carry over one hundred and fifty starfighters in their hangar bays. The [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]], [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 starfighters]] and, later in the Clone Wars, [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-wing starfighters]] comprised a large part of the fleet's fighter complement.

<div style="float:right">[[File:Venator3.jpg|thumb|200px|A ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer of the Open Circle Fleet above [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].]]</div>

At the suggestion of Anakin Skywalker, some of the ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers of the Open Circle Fleet were equipped with a heavy [[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery|SPHA]] [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannon that was installed within the ventral hangar bay. These weapons would prove to be a nasty surprise for unsuspecting Separatist warships.

During the Outer Rim Sieges, the Open Circle Armada performed admirably, defeating the CIS warships over such worlds as [[Maramere]], [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]], and [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]]. The fleet was suddenly called back to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] when word arrived that [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] had launched a surprise attack on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and was plotting to kidnap the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]. With Kenobi and Skywalker leading the starfighter squadrons once more into battle, the ships of the Open Circle Fleet engaged the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|enemy armada]]. A thousand of the armada's ''Venator''s were fast enough to reach Coruscant to catch the invaders under the planet's outer shields. The Open Circle Fleet would play a vital role in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].

[[File:Christophsis-skylane.png|thumb|left|200px|A landed ''Acclamator''-class assault ship with Open Circle Fleet markings is visible between the skyscrapers of [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].]]

While the larger ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers went head-to-head with the Separatist [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], it was Obi-Wan and Anakin, with Squad Seven providing cover, who fought through deadly swarms of [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]] and [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droids]] to reach Grievous' flagship, the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], where Grievous and Dooku were commanding the Separatist forces. This was also the location where the kidnapped [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was being held.

By the end of the battle, ''Invisible Hand'' had crash landed on Coruscant, damaged beyond repair, while Grievous escaped, [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] had been killed, and Palpatine had been rescued by the Jedi. The remaining enemy ships had no choice but to retreat. The members of the Open Circle Fleet had saved the day again.

[[File:Spacebattle.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The ships of the Open Circle Armada [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|engage]] the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Separatist Fleet]] above [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].]]

During the intrigues of the last days of the Republic, Skywalker and Kenobi undertook divergent missions. The assets of the Open Circle were likewise divided: Yoda took at least one ''Venator'' to reinforce the Loyalist armies on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Other units went to the battlefields of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], and possibly other smaller conflicts.

When Palpatine put [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] into effect, the clone pilots of the fleet turned their guns against the Jedi commanders with the order's transmission. After the reorganization of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the ships of the Open Circle Armada were incorporated as part of the new [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==Emblem==
[[File:Acclamator-TCWIV.png|thumb|left|200px|An ''Acclamator''-class assault ship of the Open Circle Fleet.]]

Ships of the Open Circle Armada were easily recognized by the distinctive red-and-yellow emblem painted onto their hulls. The heraldic emblem consisted of a yellow circle that was formed by two separate semi-circle arcs. One arc represented Kenobi, the other, Skywalker. The image signified that while they were both two independent halves, together they formed a single entity. The symbol was awarded to their fleet for its courageous and distinguished actions in the war against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Although often used to identify Open Circle Fleet vessels, this emblem eventually spread to many other units in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. When the armada was absorbed into the Imperial Navy, the emblem that the ships of the Open Circle had borne with pride was replaced with the uniform gray of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|the Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The computer artists who implemented the design of the insignia originally intended it to be a generic symbol of the Republic military, which is why it appears on Republic vehicles throughout the galaxy in ''[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|Revenge of the Sith]]''. A number of Expanded Universe writers, however, seem either to have only been shown images from the opening battle sequence or to have missed the symbol's appearance on vehicles of other Republic battalions, leading to a continuity discord with the lore regarding the Open Circle Fleet. This was quickly retconned, however, with the explanation that Fleet munitions and cargo were dispersed among other Republic units and (in the case of the symbol's appearance on a crate at the Separatist headquarters on Mustafar) even captured by Separatist pirates on occasion.

In the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]] version of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], there are crates with the insignia of the Open Circle Fleet. In the Xbox 360 version, the insignia appears on various pieces of scrap metal on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].

In ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]'' maps, some of the Republic vehicles such as the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] and [[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|AT-AP]] have Open Circle Fleet symbols. These symbols appear in the color of the team using the vehicles.
